ana (AE): FYI customer sent one big POST with 8k messages, got 413. Need a fast workaround for their Friday demo.
reid (SE): What's the exact content-length? Shape?
ana (AE): ~9.7MB JSON, they're batching examples client-side into one call assuming 65k token model handles it.
sam (runtime): Hosted ingress default is 8MB. Logs: ingress: reject body_size=9.7MB > max_body=8MB.
reid (SE): Short options: 1) client chunk + SDK assemble, 2) pointer (upload blob and send URL for server fetch), 3) temporary ingress bump for org.
ana (AE): Security forbids external presigns, pointer might be blocked. Can we do temp bump?
sam (runtime): I can request a scoped increase to 16MB for 72h, needs security signoff. I'll open change ticket.
ops-bot: ticket CHG-4121 created: "ingress bump for pocteam-org" assigned to eng-infra.
reid (SE): Cost note for customer: Billing is per-token. Multiple calls that re-send long system prompts will increase billed tokens. Pointer + single call is cheapest; chunking with session state avoids duplication but needs client changes.
ana (AE): OK. I'll tell customer pointer is preferred if security allows; otherwise we'll try temporary bump and provide chunking sample. Update when ticket moves.
sam (runtime): Action: open ticket, attach logs, request EOD approval.
